This role supports the automation of build, test, integration, and release activities to improve software quality, development efficiency, and delivery reliability. The position works closely with embedded software, systems, test, and quality teams to implement scalable engineering practices and ensure robust software lifecycle management. Job Description Design, implement, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines for embedded software development, integration, testing, and release. Support firmware and embedded software build automation for platforms and related control systems. Integrate white box and unit-level testing into CI pipelines for early defect detection. Troubleshoot build failures, pipeline issues, and test environment problems. Develop scripts and tools to improve engineering productivity and reduce manual effort. Support software quality, traceability, and release readiness across product development programs. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align CI/CD practices with embedded development needs. Maintain technical documentation, standards, and best practices for software delivery processes. Employee Specifications ≥Master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering. 5+ years of experience in software engineering, DevOps, build and release engineering, or CI/CD automation. Strong knowledge of CI/CD, DevOps, and automation practices; Jenkins, Git and Python, Bash, PowerShell, SonarQube, Sonar Cloud, or similar quality tools. Experience in motor control, connected devices, battery systems, or related embedded product domains. Experience with embedded software build, integration, and release processes. Strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and drive continuous improvement Familiarity with Agile development methodologies Proficient in English, both written and spoken. newJobs.descriptionText: Yahoo Mail is the ultimate consumer inbox with hundreds of millions of users. It’s the best way to access your email and stay organized from a computer, phone or tablet. With its beautiful design and lightning fast speed, Yahoo Mail makes reading, organizing, and sending emails easier than ever. About Us Yahoo Mail AntiSpam Engineering: The Yahoo Mail AntiSpam team develops and maintains high-performing systems that reliably protect our users from spam, phishing, fraud, and abuse with advanced ML/AI algorithms. These systems require extreme reliability, resilience, and performance. We are tackling some of the toughest challenges in architecture design, algorithm development, and data engineering, and there are innumerable opportunities to innovate across all of these areas. Yahoo Mail Delivery Engineering: The Yahoo Mail Delivery team develops and maintains high-performing systems that reliably deliver billions of messages a day to users and the wider Internet. The system requires extreme reliability, resilience, and performance. It is the critical infrastructure that transfers messages across systems, and the team works on problems spanning web services, email RFCs, and networking layers. As a global email provider, Yahoo Mail is the ultimate consumer inbox, serving more than 220 million users. It is the best way to access your email and stay organized from a computer, phone, or tablet. We handle billions of inbound connections per day and manage trillions of messages that require petabytes of efficient storage. Come join this team of engineers, product managers, and designers building next-generation experiences that transform how people connect every day. We are also in the middle of a major modernization effort, moving toward cloud-native infrastructure to improve scale, reliability, and automation. We are also an AI-forward team, actively deepening how we use agentic AI in our daily engineering. It is an exciting time to contribute. The role This role sits on the AntiSpam and Delivery team, where you will help build the systems that detect spam and abuse and deliver billions of messages a day. At IC3, what you need to accomplish is clear; how to accomplish it often is not. You will work under minimal guidance, make decisions independently, review code and give constructive feedback, and create technical designs with simplicity in mind. What You Will Do Build and operate distributed systems for inbound protection, entity reputation, traffic shaping, and message delivery. Use AI-assisted development tools as part of your daily workflow, validating and refining what they produce rather than accepting it blindly. Translate defined technical requirements into correct, readable, testable code, and deploy continuously to production. Troubleshoot software failures and tune performance across high-throughput services. Design and simplify existing components under minimal guidance. Review peers' code, give constructive feedback, and help with estimation. Minimum Qualifications BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field, with a strong grasp of fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and networking. Proficiency with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Codex, with sound judgment over correctness, security, and maintainability. 3+ years of backend-focused software development experience in Java, Go, or C++ (we are primarily a Java team, with some systems in Go). Solid understanding of cloud computing concepts: IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS. Machine learning knowledge with some hands-on AI coding experience. Experience with a public cloud (GCP or AWS). Experience with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes), preferably on GCP. Experience designing and building high-performing, complex server applications on Unix/Linux. Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills, including performance tuning. A clear communicator who enjoys helping people and stays constructive under pressure. Preferred Qualifications Strong understanding of network programming and client/server architecture. Familiarity with best practices for cloud security, scalability, and performance optimization. Professional experience with high-availability, high-throughput distributed systems. Experience with big data technologies such as Hadoop, HBase, and Spark. Experience in algorithm design and ML/AI. Experience with queuing and streaming technologies such as Kafka or Apache Storm. Experience with databases such as PostgreSQL. Working knowledge of a scripting language such as Python, Perl, or Ruby. Knowledge of Scrum and Agile methodologies. The material job duties and responsibilities of this role include those listed above as well as adhering to Yahoo policies; exercising sound judgment; working effectively, safely and inclusively with others; exhibiting trustworthiness and meeting expectations; and safeguarding business operations and brand integrity. At Yahoo, we offer flexible hybrid work options that our employees love! While most roles don’t require regular office attendance, you may occasionally be asked to attend in-person events or team sessions. You’ll always get notice to make arrangements. Your recruiter will let you know if a specific job requires regular attendance at a Yahoo office or facility. If you have any questions about how this applies to the role, just ask the recruiter! Yahoo is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

newJobs.title: Fullstack Software Dev Engineer II
newJobs.descriptionText: It takes powerful technology to connect our brands and partners with an audience of hundreds of millions of people. Whether you’re looking to write mobile app code, engineer the servers behind our massive ad tech stacks, or develop algorithms to help us process trillions of data points a day, what you do here will have a huge impact on our business—and the world. About the Team Identity platforms at Yahoo provide modern, secure identity offerings for consumers and businesses interacting with Yahoo systems. These platforms operate at massive scale, serving hundreds of millions of users every day, and power critical authentication, authorization, and account management capabilities across Yahoo products. As part of Yahoo’s transition to an AI-First engineering model, teams increasingly leverage AI-assisted development environments (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) combined with Spec-Driven Development (SDD) workflows, to accelerate delivery while maintaining high engineering quality. About the Role We are looking for a Full Stack Software Dev Engineer II to join our Identity organization. You will work across the stack to build secure, scalable, and user-friendly authentication and account management experiences that serve hundreds of millions of users globally. In this role, you will work independently with minimal guidance, owning critical features and acting as a technical resource for your peers. A core expectation is the ability to collaborate effectively with AI systems—using structured specs, deep codebase context, and prompt modeling to guide high-quality software implementation. We seek engineers who possess an experimentation-forward mindset and view AI as a force multiplier for architectural excellence and team-wide productivity. Responsibilities Design, build, and operate secure, scalable full-stack identity systems using ReactJS, TypeScript, Java, and Node.js. Own complex features and standalone project phases end-to-end, from gathering requirements and systems design to implementation, testing, and production. Lead an AI-first development workflow within the squad, writing precise markdown specifications to drive AI-assisted code generation (Cursor, Claude Code), and taking responsibility for the rigorous validation, testing, and safety of all generated assets. Identify system bottlenecks, enhance platform reliability, and debug complex production issues in our high-traffic distributed identity systems. Proactively research and implement AI-driven efficiencies in your daily coding workflows, replacing repetitive manual tasks with structured automation, custom templates, and AI-assisted testing. Act as a technical resource for the team by sharing successful prompt engineering patterns, context modeling strategies, and workflow optimizations that level up the overall engineering velocity of the squad. Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Managers, UX Designers, Security Engineers, and other Yahoo product squads to coordinate technical integrations. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 4–6 years of professional full-stack software engineering experience. Strong hands-on engineering experience using Java for robust backend services. Experience building responsive, high-performance web applications using React.js, Node.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as Next.js. Strong core engineering fundamentals in distributed system design, API development, databases, and web security. Demonstrated experience integrating AI-assisted developer tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) into day-to-day software development workflows to build and refactor production-grade systems. Practical understanding of prompt engineering, model limitations, and structured context assembly to generate robust code outputs. Proven capability to evaluate, audit, and debug AI-generated outputs, ensuring alignment with Yahoo’s high standards for code quality, security protocols, and performance. Experience with testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and writing production-ready, highly maintainable tests. Preferred Qualifications Experience building or maintaining high-scale Identity and Access Management (IAM) systems, auth protocols (OAuth, OIDC, SAML), or web security standards. Cloud platform experience (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and infrastructure-as-code. Familiarity with observability tools (Splunk, Grafana) and client/server performance profiling. Experience with structured development methodologies, such as Spec-Driven Development (SDD), API-first design, or AI-assisted diagnostic tools. Exposure to web accessibility (WCAG), internationalization, or large-scale consumer product delivery. What Success Looks Like Consistently deliver high-quality, high-impact features independently, ensuring secure user authentication experiences for hundreds of millions of users. Masterfully leverage AI-assisted tools to significantly compress development lifecycles while maintaining an ultra-high bar for security compliance and test coverage. Raise overall engineering standards by contributing to system architecture discussions, documenting clear technical specifications, and mentoring junior engineers. Accelerate squad velocity by sharing innovative, repeatable ways to integrate AI workflows into daily development, testing, and troubleshooting activities. The material job duties and responsibilities of this role include those listed above as well as adhering to Yahoo policies; exercising sound judgment; working effectively, safely and inclusively with others; exhibiting trustworthiness and meeting expectations; and safeguarding business operations and brand integrity. Sunrise Blvd, Plantation, FL 33322 Akumin is a leading provider of outpatient radiology and oncology services, partnering with top hospitals and health systems nationwide to deliver advanced diagnostic imaging and exceptional patient care close to home. The role of the Field Support Technician is to provide full-time, office-based technical support, serving as the primary physical anchor for our corporate headquarters. Working under a tiered support model, the technician’s primary responsibility is to deliver direct, on-site assistance to staff and systems at the main office, followed by providing local hands-on technical support at our neighboring locations as needed. Additionally, the role is responsible for managing the centralized call queue and IT ticketing system to provide comprehensive remote troubleshooting and support for all other offices, clinical locations, and remote users across the United States. Local On-Site Support (Secondary): Travels to neighboring office and clinical locations as needed to deliver hands-on technical assistance, hardware deployments, and physical system troubleshooting. Clinical & Corporate Systems Troubleshooting: Troubleshoots workflows, functionality, and remote connectivity issues for clinical systems (such as radiology/imaging systems) and corporate software applications. Administration & Operations: Monitors local system uptime, assists with IT asset tracking, and performs other duties and projects as assigned by management. newJobs.descriptionText: Lead Engineer--Model-Based Design, Systems Verification & Validation Towson, MD Come make the world and accelerate your success. It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. People who care about making things better For Those Who Make The World™. Sound like you? Join our top-notch team of approximately 43,500 diverse and high-performing professionals globally who are making their mark on some of the world’s most beloved brands, including DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET®, and HUSTLER®. The Job: As a Lead Engineer, you’ll be part of our Electronics & Electrical team working as a hybrid employee. The Senior Project Engineer / Lead Engineer - Model-Based Design, Systems Verification & Validation will play a key role in advancing model-based development practices across the Electronics & Electrical Systems group. This role is focused on building and applying system models to support product development, requirements decomposition, system behavior definition, verification planning, and validation execution for electrical and electronic systems. The position is intended for an engineer with a strong foundation in Model-Based Design (MBD), systems engineering, and verification and validation (V&V), with the ability to support cross-functional teams through the full product development lifecycle. The engineer will work closely with development, testing, controls, hardware, firmware, and integration teams to improve design quality, accelerate issue resolution, and strengthen confidence in system performance before and during physical validation. This role is best suited for a senior-level engineer who can connect requirements, models, simulation results, and test outcomes into a structured development and validation framework, while helping teams adopt consistent and scalable MBD practices. You’ll get to: Lead and support model-based design activities for electrical and electronic systems, with emphasis on system behavior modeling, requirements alignment, and verification support. Develop and maintain system and subsystem models using MATLAB/Simulink/Stateflow, TwinBuilder, Dymola, Modelica, Ansys, LTSPice and related libraries/tools as appropriate. Use models to support requirements decomposition, interface definition, architecture evaluation, and early design verification. Define and execute verification and validation strategies that connect requirements, models, simulation outputs, and physical test results. Utilize simulation packages and define simulation process flows to rapidly identify root causes of Signal Integrity, ESD, & EMI related issues that arise during product development. Communicate and train the development engineers on how to apply these processes to his/her project. Support development teams by using models and simulations to evaluate concepts, identify design gaps, and reduce technical risk early in the product lifecycle. Support testing teams by helping define test cases, expected behaviors, acceptance criteria, and model-to-test correlation methods. Support integration teams by identifying subsystem interactions, interface issues, and system-level behavior risks before and during integration. Contribute to MIL, SIL, and HIL workflows where applicable to improve verification coverage and development efficiency. Analyze discrepancies between expected and observed system behavior and drive structured root cause investigation using model and test data. Help establish and improve MBD, verification, and validation best practices, workflows, templates, and reusable libraries across the organization. Collaborate with systems, controls, firmware, hardware, validation, and quality teams to ensure strong technical alignment throughout development. Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and contribute to design reviews, verification reviews, and cross-functional engineering decisions. The Person: You love to learn and grow and be acknowledged for your valuable contributions. You’re not intimidated by innovation. Wouldn’t it be great if you could do your job and do a world of good? In fact, you embrace it. You also have: Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field 8+ years of engineering experience in model-based design, systems engineering, verification and validation, controls development, or related product development environments Strong experience with MATLAB / Simulink / Stateflow/Ansys Strong understanding of Model-Based Design principles, system modeling methodologies, and simulation-driven development Experience supporting systems verification and validation, including requirement traceability, test planning, and model-to-test correlation Experience working across cross-functional teams including development, testing, and system integration Ability to translate system requirements into model structures, verification logic, and validation approaches Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience investigating complex system As a Lead / Principal - Mechanism & Multi-Body Dynamics Engineer, you’ll be part of our Tools & Outdoor team working as a hybrid employee. You’ll get to: Develop, maintain, and refine kinematic and dynamic models of mechanical systems using MBD tools such as MSC Adams, MotionSolve, Ansys Motion, RecurDyn, or Simscape Multibody. Perform subsystem and system-level analysis of drivetrains, linkages, gear trains, actuation systems, impact mechanisms, rotating assemblies, and related mechanism-driven hardware. Build and integrate flexible body models through FEA-MBD co-simulation workflows using tools such as ANSYS, LS-DYNA, NASTRAN, or RADIOSS. Generate load cases, interface forces, joint reactions, torque histories, and transient event data for structural, durability, and fatigue analysis teams. Support mechanism-specific modeling for products involving power transmission, motion conversion, latch/lock systems, clutching elements, and high-speed or high-load dynamic events. Correlate simulation outputs against bench, subsystem, and full-system physical test data, and update models to improve predictive accuracy. Conduct DOE, sensitivity studies, and parameter sweeps to optimize mechanism performance and improve robustness across operating conditions. Collaborate with mechanical design teams to define assumptions for joints, contacts, friction, damping, stiffness, inertia properties, and boundary conditions. Support co-simulation workflows including FMI/FMU-based frameworks and Adams-Simulink co-simulation where plant dynamics influence system behavior. Develop scripts and automation tools using Python, MATLAB, or Adams/View macro scripting to improve model setup, post-processing, and reporting. Document model assumptions, validation methods, simulation results, and recommendations in a review-ready format for cross-functional stakeholders. The Person: You love to learn and grow and be acknowledged for your valuable contributions. You’re not intimidated by innovation. Wouldn’t it be great if you could do your job and do a world of good? In fact, you embrace it. You also have: Master’s or Ph.D. degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Applied Mechanics, Engineering Mechanics, or a related technical field. Typically 5+ years of relevant experience in mechanism analysis, multi-body dynamics, or simulation of mechanical systems; advanced degree may offset a portion of experience. 10+ years of relevant CAE experience in product development Demonstrated experience with one or more commercial MBD tools such as MSC Adams, MotionSolve, Ansys Motion, RecurDyn, or Simscape Multibody. Strong fundamentals in rigid body dynamics, kinematics, Lagrangian mechanics, constraint systems, contact mechanics, and force element modeling. Experience developing models for mechanical systems with multiple moving bodies, joints, contacts, and nonlinear interactions. Experience creating simulation outputs that support structural analysis, fatigue assessment, wear or durability engineering. Experience correlating simulation predictions with physical test data and improving models based on measured results. Working knowledge of flexible body modeling and interaction between MBD and finite element representations. Proficiency in technical scripting or automation using Python, MATLAB, or equivalent tools. Working knowledge of structured coding languages C#, C++ or equivalent. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively across design, test, and analysis functions. Preferred Qualifications: Mechanism Design Background Experience designing or supporting the design of mechanisms, drivetrains, gear systems, linkages, cams, clutches, or actuation hardware. Strong understanding of mechanical packaging, tolerance effects, manufacturability, assembly constraints, and real-world hardware behavior. Ability to translate CAD-based product architecture into efficient and representative simulation models. Experience working directly with product development teams to influence mechanism concept selection, layout decisions, and design tradeoffs. Familiarity with industrial equipment, power tools, drilling tools, or other ruggedized hardware operating in demanding environments. Job Description: We are seeking a highly talented and experienced Senior AI Fabric Performance Engineer to take on a critical role within our Performance Lab. Job Description: Process and Integration Engineer, Optoelectronics We are seeking a highly skilled Process Integration Engineer to join our Optical Systems Division. This position is pivotal to the efficient and profitable manufacturing of microelectronic laser and detector products. In this 100% on-site position in our fast-paced, 24/7 manufacturing environment, the successful candidate will serve as the technical authority for the facet coating process, driving improvements in productivity, yield, quality, and reliability across both internal operations and subcontractor facilities and will collaborate cross-functionally to ensure operational excellence and meet critical production commitments. Technical Proficiency: Solid understanding of vacuum physics and deposition techniques (IBS, ALD) and dielectric coating materials (e.g., Al2O3, SiO2, Ta2O5, TiO2, Si3N4). Located in the Lehigh Valley region of Pennsylvania just outside of Allentown, our high volume, 24/7 manufacturing facility fabricates devices that enable fiber optic communication and datacenter expansion. newJobs.descriptionText: Yahoo Mail is the ultimate consumer inbox with hundreds of millions of users. It’s the best way to access your email and stay organized from a computer, phone or tablet. With its beautiful design and lightning fast speed, Yahoo Mail makes reading, organizing, and sending emails easier than ever. A Little About Us Yahoo Mail is the ultimate Consumer Inbox with over 220 million monthly active users. We empower users to run the business of their lives through a fast, intuitive platform while managing billions of daily inbound connections and petabytes of efficient storage. Our engineering team is actively transitioning to a 100% native public cloud architecture. The Mail Intelligence Org develops intelligent capabilities at scale to uncover user interests, reveal habits, and personalize user journeys across Yahoo Mail and the broader Yahoo ecosystem. We manage billions of messages using advanced backend systems and state-of-the-art AI - including NLP, Generative AI, and autonomous agentic workflows. We are a team of passionate engineers dedicated to high coding standards, world-class architecture, and an owner’s mindset. A Lot About You AI-First Mindset: AI is core to how you work, innovate, and deliver results. You actively experiment with advanced tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, Codex), integrate them into your daily development workflows, and measure success by how effectively you leverage AI to solve complex problems. Agentic Thinker: You have hands-on experience designing, orchestrating, and evaluating agentic systems (multi-step reasoning, tool integration, memory, autonomous workflows, and LLM-based agents) in production environments. Engineering Standards: You take extreme ownership of your work, bringing high engineering rigor, clean code practices, and a focus on building scalable, fault-tolerant architectures. Collaborative Partner: You thrive in cross-functional, global engineering environments, working closely with Tech Leads, Architects, and Engineers to deliver robust features. Continuous Learner: You stay on the cutting edge of rapid advancements in machine learning, generative models, and infrastructure trends, continuously bringing novel approaches into practice. Responsibilities Architect & Personalize: Design, build, and deploy high-throughput AI/ML capabilities that power real-time personalization and deep insights for hundreds of millions of users. GenAI & Agentic Systems: Spearhead the implementation and orchestration of production LLM-backed applications and agentic workflows (prompt engineering, tool integration, and automated feedback loops). AI-Driven Execution: Embed AI-first practices into daily development cycles using AI-assisted tools to accelerate iteration, improve code quality, and modernize engineering workflows. Data-Driven Intelligence: Process petabyte-scale data streams using big data processing and ML techniques to derive key insights from mail metadata and content. Inference at Scale: Deploy and optimize ML/LLM models for real-time production serving using modern frameworks (e.g., vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton, ONNX Runtime). Resilience & Fallback Design: Implement automated feedback loops and graceful recovery paths to handle model failure modes smoothly, maintaining high service availability and user satisfaction. Tradeoff Management: Balance compute costs, latency, quality, and model performance to optimize systems for massive consumer scale. Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, or a related field; or, equivalent experience. Experience: 5+ years of professional experience engineering and deploying production machine learning or data science systems at scale. Technical Proficiency: Proficient in Python or Java, with deep hands-on expertise in standard ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, Scikit-learn). Generative & Agentic AI: Demonstrated experience building LLM-based applications or agentic systems (multi-step reasoning, tool usage, RAG, or autonomous workflows). High-Performance Inference: Experience deploying and serving models in production using tools like vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, or ONNX Runtime. Big Data Handling: Hands-on experience processing large datasets using Spark, Hadoop, or cloud-native data pipelines. Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills for effective collaboration with cross-functional and global engineering teams. Preferred Qualifications Cloud Infrastructure: Direct experience building and scaling ML pipelines on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or similar native public cloud environments. Domain Expertise: Prior experience working with email systems, large-scale consumer web platforms, NLP, or search architecture. AI Tooling: Early adoption and proactive integration of modern developer tooling (Cursor, Claude, Codex) directly into daily development practices. The material job duties and responsibilities of this role include those listed above as well as adhering to Yahoo policies; exercising sound judgment; working effectively, safely and inclusively with others; exhibiting trustworthiness and meeting expectations; and safeguarding business operations and brand integrity. At Yahoo, we offer flexible hybrid work options that our employees love! While most roles don’t require regular office attendance, you may occasionally be asked to attend in-person events or team sessions. You’ll always get notice to make arrangements. Your recruiter will let you know if a specific job requires regular attendance at a Yahoo office or facility. If you have any questions about how this applies to the role, just ask the recruiter! Yahoo is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

newJobs.descriptionText: It takes powerful technology to connect our brands and partners with an audience of hundreds of millions of people. Whether you’re looking to write mobile app code, engineer the servers behind our massive ad tech stacks, or develop algorithms to help us process trillions of data points a day, what you do here will have a huge impact on our business—and the world. A Little About Us Yahoo's Media Platform team enables core media business capabilities across Yahoo products in News, Finance, and Sports. We provide products and services to help each product enable use cases faster and cost-effectively. As a result, they can leverage advanced capabilities that any independent vertical would not be able to buy or build. The Content Management team in the Media Platform aims to create the best experience for content creators, from onboarding to audience engagement. As a Principal Software Dev Engineer you will serve as the technical lead for a full-stack engineering team, driving the strategic vision and execution of cutting-edge solutions, for example integrating AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) to enhance content creation and enrichments. Collaborate with Product and Business leaders to deliver scalable, reusable components. These include microservices and cloud-native solutions. In addition, you will work closely with Data Science and Engineering teams to leverage data-driven insights and machine learning to continuously optimize user experiences. This role offers an exciting opportunity to leverage your expertise in agile methodologies and cloud technologies, while building strong cross-functional partnerships and leading impactful initiatives. A Lot About You We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Principal Software Dev Engineer to act as the technical lead for one of our content management engineering teams. In this role, you will set the technical direction for the team, break down complex initiatives into executable work, and ensure the squad delivers high‑quality software on time. You will harness your deep expertise in full-stack development to drive software solutions, and collaborate closely with stakeholders to ensure projects exceed expectations. You will be diving into cutting-edge technologies, leveraging AI and Large Language Models (LLM), and know how to apply those principles into existing and new architectures. You will collaborate with cross-functional leaders in Product, Design, and Business to drive strategic goals and deliver impactful results. You have a proven track record of leading functional teams or complex initiatives across multiple workstreams, driving technical decisions and delivering outcomes that impact multiple products or customer experiences. newJobs.descriptionText: Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We help healthcare organizations build innovation capabilities and accelerate key growth initiatives, enabling organizations to own the future, instead of being disrupted by it. Together, we empower clients to create sustainable growth, optimize internal processes and deliver better consumer outcomes. Health systems, hospitals and medical clinics are under immense pressure to improve clinical outcomes and reduce the cost of providing patient care. Investing in new partnerships, clinical services and technology is not enough to create meaningful and substantive change. To succeed long-term, healthcare organizations must empower leaders, clinicians, employees, affiliates and communities to build cultures that foster innovation to achieve the best outcomes for patients. Joining the Huron team means you’ll help our clients evolve and adapt to the rapidly changing healthcare environment and optimize existing business operations, improve clinical outcomes, create a more consumer-centric healthcare experience, and drive physician, patient and employee engagement across the enterprise. Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future. Market Insights is Huron's analytics product suite, built on a foundation of tens of billions of medical claims, millions of clinical providers, and hundreds of millions of unique patient lives. We are looking for a Full Stack Lead Engineer to guide the technical direction of this platform end to end, from the data layer through the user interface, with a mandate to embed AI directly into how our analytics products are built and how they deliver insight to clients. This is a hands on leadership role. You will write and review code, set architecture and technical standards, and lead a team of engineers, while partnering closely with product management, data engineering, and data science to bring intelligent, AI enabled analytics capabilities to market faster. Responsibilities Full stack product development Lead design and development across the stack: responsive front end interfaces, APIs and services, and the underlying data layer for analytics products. Set technical direction and architecture for scalability, security, and performance of AWS based analytics solutions. Collaborate with product management on roadmap, prioritization, and feature delivery using Agile practices. AI and machine learning in analytics Identify and lead opportunities to embed AI and Agentic AI capabilities into analytics products: predictive models, natural language interfaces over data, automated insight generation, and generative AI features that help clients act faster on their data. Partner with data scientists to move machine learning models from prototype into reliable, production grade services. Evaluate and apply large language model based tools where they add measurable client value, with attention to data privacy, accuracy, and healthcare compliance requirements. Data engineering Design and maintain ETL and data pipeline processes that feed dashboards, models, and client facing reporting. Work with cloud data services, including S3, Redshift, Glue, Lambda, and Athena, to build scalable data infrastructure. Uphold data governance, quality, and healthcare data handling standards across the platform. Team leadership Support, and mentor a team of engineers, providing technical guidance and career development. Establish and continuously improve engineering practices, code quality standards, and delivery processes. Communicate progress, risks, and technical decisions clearly to product leadership and cross functional stakeholders. Qualifications Required: 8 or more years of professional software engineering experience, including full stack development across both front end and back end technologies. 3 or more years leading or mentoring engineers, formally or informally. Demonstrated experience applying AI or machine learning within a production analytics or data product, such as predictive modeling, recommendation systems, or generative AI features. Strong front end development skills in TypeScript, JavaScript, and React. Strong back end skills in Python, and an equivalent language used for analytics and API development. Solid understanding of relational databases and SQL. Working knowledge of core AWS services relevant to data and analytics, including Lambda, IAM, S3, Redshift, Glue, and Athena. Experience with infrastructure as code using AWS CloudFormation and the AWS CDK. Experience with version control systems, particularly Git. Experience delivering software using Agile methodologies. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders. Preferred: Familiarity with healthcare data interoperability standards, such as ANSI X12, HL7, and FHIR. Experience with healthcare claims data is a plus. Hands on experience with large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval augmented generation, or vector databases. Experience with MLOps practices for deploying and monitoring machine learning models in production. Experience with SQLAlchemy and PostgreSQL. Experience with row based databases such as Amazon RDS and Aurora. Experience with columnar or data warehouse platforms such as Redshift, Athena, and Snowflake. Experience with NoSQL databases such as DynamoDB. Experience with a broader range of AWS services beyond the core set, and with Azure DevOps for build and release pipelines. Experience with big data technologies such as Spark, or infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform. Background in healthcare or higher education analytics. AWS certification, such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect or AWS Certified Developer. A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Job Description: Job Description - Intro Broadcom’s Mainframe Software Division (MSD) is looking for a seasoned Software Engineer with a talent for developing software for the mainframe and leading a team dedicated to quality, security, and a smooth user experience. This role is in the Mainframe DevOps value stream, as a software engineer for one of our flagship products, Gen (formerly known as COOL:Gen or CA Gen). Gen is a low-code, model-driven development environment for enterprise applications. Gen enables global enterprises to generate and deploy applications in a single, integrated development environment for multiple platforms. Broadcom has earned scores of global Workplace Excellence awards in the last few years - and there's a reason for that. It’s our aim to encourage global collaboration and innovation while supporting and developing our talented workforce. Broadcom empowers its employees to drive success for both the business and themselves. We value a lean and flat organization, with team members who work in-office, for a more collaborative culture that focuses on execution and delivering value. #BroadcomSoftware The Opportunity As a Mainframe Software Engineer (ICB 5), you will take ownership of the development, core architecture, and ongoing evolution of Gen (formerly known as COOL: Gen or CA Gen). This is a high-impact, visible role where you will apply your advanced mainframe expertise to influence all levels of product delivery. You will guide architectural design, spearhead secure coding standards, and act as a technical mentor to other engineers. This is a hands-on technical role: you will write code, lead code reviews, and influence testing strategy. Concurrently, you will serve as a subject matter expert and thought leader in partnership with product management and customers. Your natural curiosity keeps you well informed of the latest technologies, and deepens your knowledge of legacy systems that are the foundation of global enterprise. Troubleshoot and fix customer cases that have been escalated to engineering. Drive technical design to ensure robust security standards, while retaining a simple user experience. Strong analytical skills and the ability to understand complex component relationships. Ability to provide technical guidance and mentor software engineers. Growth mindset with a commitment to continuous personal and professional development. Deep expertise and hands-on coding experience in COBOL, IBM Assembler Experience working with middleware, such as ECI, TCP/IP or IBM MQ. This role will report directly to the Vice President, Engineering & Technology (Americas & EMEA) and will lead two sub-groups: a team of embedded Systems Engineers deployed to programs and the Engineering Processes & Quality group, which owns stage-gate technical readiness, engineering quality audits, and engineering standard work. You’ll get to: Build and lead the Systems Engineering capability for the Americas and EMEA engineering organization, including defining the operating model, engagement model with programs, and standard ways of working for embedded Systems Engineers deployed to programs. Recruit, develop, and deploy Systems Engineers who partner with program teams to lead requirements decomposition, interface control, integration analysis, and system-level technical readiness activities. Lead the implementation of systems-engineering methods, tools, and standard work across programs, including requirements management, traceability, and model-based systems engineering practices from customer need through verification. Drive verification and validation rigor by ensuring programs establish clear V&V plans, test coverage against critical-to-quality requirements, and evidence-based design review gates. Establish and scale the organization’s design-risk and functional-safety analysis discipline by driving consistent hazard analysis, DFMEA, and fault-tree analysis in partnership with Electrical Engineering and other functional teams. Lead the Engineering Processes & Quality group in deploying stage-gate technical readiness expectations, engineering quality audits, and engineering standard work across Americas and EMEA design centers in alignment with broader Engineering Excellence direction. newJobs.descriptionText: Principal – Principal Systems MBD Engineer - Hybrid This position requires onsite work three days per week at our Towson, MD campus. Towson, MD, United States Come build something that matters. It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. People who care about making things better For Those Who Make The World™. Sound like you? Join our top-notch team of approximately 43,500 diverse and high-performing professionals globally who are making their mark on some of the world’s most beloved brands, including DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET®, and HUSTLER®. The Job: The Systems Model Based Development Engineer will lead the development of advanced plant models, simulation frameworks, and engineering applications supporting next-generation electromechanical product development. As a Principal – Principal Systems MBD Engineer Here, you’ll be part of our Tools and Outdoor team, working as a hybrid employee. You’ll get to: Lead development of high-fidelity plant models for complex electromechanical systems using Dymola, TwinBuilder, Amesim, Modelica, Simulink, and Simscape or equivalent tools. Develop multi-scale and multi-domain models spanning component, subsystem, and system-level behavior across electrical, mechanical, thermal, hydraulic, pneumatic, and controls-coupled domains. Translate abstract methods, first-principles equations, reduced-order formulations, and engineering concepts into practical, validated, and reusable simulation models. Perform custom model and library development to represent unique physics, behaviors, interfaces, and product architectures not available in standard toolsets. Build supporting engineering applications, scripts, utilities, and automation workflows to improve model usability, execution speed, and integration into development processes. Support code generation, model compilation, solver configuration, co-simulation setup, FMU export/import, and runtime integration across development environments. Create interfaces between plant models and external applications, controllers, embedded software components, and test platforms. Partner with CAE engineers to align system-level and reduced-order models with detailed simulation results, test data, and product physics. Collaborate with MBD and controls engineers to provide plant models suitable for MIL, SIL, HIL, and closed-loop controls development. Work with embedded software engineers to support executable deployment, runtime validation, and integration of models into software and test ecosystems. Perform model verification, validation, calibration, sensitivity analysis, and performance optimization using simulation and test data. Contribute to simulation architecture decisions related to model reuse, interoperability, deployment strategy, abstraction level, and framework scalability. newJobs.descriptionText: GoodRx is the leading prescription savings platform in the U.S. Trusted by more than 25 million consumers and 750,000 healthcare professionals annually, GoodRx provides access to savings and affordability options for generic and brand-name medications at more than 70,000 pharmacies nationwide, as well as comprehensive healthcare research and information. Since 2011, GoodRx has helped consumers save nearly $75 billion on the cost of their prescriptions. Our goal is to help Americans find convenient and affordable healthcare. We offer solutions for consumers, employers, health plans, and anyone else who shares our desire to provide affordable prescriptions to all Americans. About the Role: As the VP, Marketing Science & Analytics you will lead and manage a team of 10 to drive business growth through data. The role includes broad responsibility for centralizing customer segmentation strategy for media activation and growth, marketing analytics and BI, privacy and regulatory compliance, ad operations, and programmatic media strategy and activation. Your role is pivotal in shaping our marketing science vision, fostering innovation, and ensuring seamless collaboration with cross-functional teams. This role owns and drives the data-driven marketing vision within the marketing team. Key Responsibilities: 1. Team Leadership and Development: Lead a team of 10+, while fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. Oversee the recruitment, training, and development of marketing science talent. Follow all company and team guidelines and processes regarding talent management and team goal setting, tracking, and attainment. 2. Relationship Building, Strategic Planning, and Enterprise Alignment: Build/maintain strong relationships with data, engineering, finance, and other team leaders in and outside of marketing. Collaborate cross-functionally to provide consistent, reliable metrics, support decision-making, and guide strategic planning. Communicate plans effectively and secure enterprise alignment for initiatives. 3. Data-driven Activation - Programmatic Media Channels and Audience Strategy: Responsible for programmatic media, optimizing audience strategy for effective marketing campaigns, and developing optimization feedback loops from program data. Develop new data product capabilities to automate workflows that power programmatic media and data collection. Building for scale, while remaining flexible to accommodate different use cases and business goals. 4. Customer Segmentation and Marketing Automation: Develop customer segmentation approach for audience selection, including technical requirements for managing audiences, and strategies for personalized marketing activation and improved customer experience. Drive marketing automation around customer lifecycle touchpoints to enhance customer insights and business predictions for Next Best Actioning. 5. Marketing Analytics and Business Intelligence: Lead marketing attribution efforts, including the integration of lift measurement, econometric modeling, and channel measurement to assess the impact of various marketing channels and guide optimization decisions. Develop and refine strategies for measuring the effectiveness of marketing initiatives and optimizing budget/time allocation. Own all reporting and insights generation for the marketing department, assessing stakeholder needs and establishing the right reporting cadence and depth of insight to meet daily business decision making requirements. Compiles roll-up reports for department-wide view of business unit performance for team business review meetings, partner reporting needs, ELT meetings, board presentations, and other ad-hoc needs. Works closely with the consumer insights team to make proactive recommendations to marketing stakeholders and goes beyond reporting metrics to providing business context and explanations for material changes in the data over time (including technical measurement issues or methodology changes). Effectively communicate marketing measurement methodology to and aligns with cross functional partners. 6. Ad Operations, Privacy, Legal Compliance, and Martech Strategy: Take ownership of ad operations to ensure seamless execution of advertising campaigns. Ensure privacy and legal compliance in all marketing activities, staying abreast of industry regulations and internal process changes. Develop and implement Martech (Marketing Technology) strategies aligned with marketing science goals. Oversee the evaluation and integration of marketing technologies to enhance efficiency. 7. Continuous Improvement: Stay up-to-date with industry-standard processes and new technologies (especially AI) in marketing science and implement improvements as needed to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of marketing data analysis. Skills & Qualifications: Bachelor's degree or above in a relevant field (e.g., Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, or other science). 20+ years of experience in marketing science, value measurement, audience profiling, performance media, and experience with AI tools Tech-driven Healthcare and/or Retail experience a plus. Strong knowledge of statistics for marketing data interpretation and modeling. Experience in pipeline management to ensure data flow and integrity. Proficiency in data visualizations to effectively communicate marketing insights. Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and guide a marketing science team. Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with ability to find truth through data and use that understanding to drive organizational alignment from within marketing. Willingness to travel as needed to meet marketing goals Engineering teams are responsible for supporting appropriate security controls, including management, operational, and technical controls in addition to general GoodRx best practices, such as reading and adhering to the security policies and procedures, being vigilant and observant of potential security threats, etc. At GoodRx, pay ranges are determined based on work locations and may vary based on where the successful candidate is hired. Our great benefits offerings include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with a company match, an ESPP, unlimited vacation, 13 paid holidays, and 72 hours of sick leave. GoodRx also offers additional benefits like mental wellness and financial wellness programs, fertility benefits, generous parental leave, pet insurance, supplemental life insurance for you and your dependents, company-paid short-term and long-term disability, and more! We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company and industry. With that said, research shows that women and other underrepresented groups apply only if they meet 100% of the criteria. GoodRx is committed to leveling the playing field, and we encourage women, people of color, those in the LGBTQ+ communities, individuals with disabilities, and Veterans to apply for positions even if they don’t necessarily check every box outlined in the job description. Please still get in touch - we’d love to connect and see if you could be good for the role! GoodRx is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities during our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please reach out to us at accommodations@goodrx.com. We prioritize candidate safety. newJobs.descriptionText: Position Summary We are looking for an experienced Lead Engineer responsible for new product development to join our R&D Engineering team. This role is responsible for leading the development of innovative new products from concept creation through production launch, with a strong focus on mechanical/structural design, engineering analysis, and product realization. This is a key technical leadership role for an engineer with deep expertise in mechanical and structural design; strength and theoretical analysis, with a strong understanding of manufacturing processes, DFM/DFA, and applicable power tool standards. Experience in developing power tools for cable cutting, wire stripping or crimping, is highly desirable. The successful candidate should also demonstrate strong English communication skills, the ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional and global environments, and strong innovation capabilities to drive product design optimization and technical breakthroughs based on customer needs, technology trends, and application scenarios. Extensive experience in the development of handheld power tools for hydraulic, cable cutting, wire stripping, crimping, and pipe processing applications is required. Key Responsibilities Product Development & Management Lead new product development from concept generation through design, validation, and production launch. Identify technical risks proactively, lead problem-solving efforts, and drive effective corrective actions throughout the development cycle. Lead design reviews, prototype builds, and engineering validation activities. Mechanical Design & Engineering Own the mechanical and structural design of products and subsystems. Perform and guide strength calculations, structural analysis, tolerance analysis, and theoretical engineering evaluations to ensure robust and reliable designs. Lead engineering team to complete concepts, 3D models, detailed drawings, specifications, and technical documentation. Transfer product requirements into practical, manufacturable solutions that balance performance, cost, quality, and user needs. Manufacturing & Cross-Functional Collaboration Apply DFM/DFA principles to improve manufacturability, production efficiency, and cost competitiveness. Partner closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Sourcing, Product Management, and Test Engineering teams to support successful product launch. Support value engineering and cost optimization initiatives and contribute to platform-based product development. Technical Leadership Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers across the R&D organization. Stay current on industry trends, materials, manufacturing technologies, and competitive products relevant to power tools and cable-processing applications. Qualifications Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree or above in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. 8+ years of experience in new product development related to hydraulic tools and pipe wrenches. Proven experience in mechanical/structural design, engineering analysis, and product commercialization. Demonstrated success delivering projects against quality, schedule, and profitability targets. Technical Skills Strong foundation in structural design, mechanical design, and engineering fundamentals. Solid experience in strength analysis, mechanical calculations, and theoretical analysis. Proficiency in 3D and 2D CAD tools and engineering drawing standards. Strong knowledge of manufacturing processes such as machining, stamping, casting, and assembly. Good understanding of DFM/DFA and production feasibility considerations. Familiarity with relevant power tool standards, product safety requirements, and industry compliance expectations. We are tackling some of the toughest challenges in architecture design, algorithm development, and data engineering, and there are innumerable opportunities to innovate across all of these areas. The system requires extreme reliability, resilience, and performance. It is the critical infrastructure that transfers messages across systems, and the team works on problems spanning web services, email RFCs, and networking layers. As a global email provider, Yahoo Mail is the ultimate consumer inbox, serving more than 220 million users. It is the best way to access your email and stay organized from a computer, phone, or tablet. We handle billions of inbound connections per day and manage trillions of messages that require petabytes of efficient storage. Come join this team of engineers, product managers, and designers building next-generation experiences that transform how people connect every day. We are also in the middle of a major modernization effort, moving toward cloud-native infrastructure to improve scale, reliability, and automation. We are also an AI-forward team, actively deepening how we use agentic AI in our daily engineering. It is an exciting time to contribute. The role This role sits on the AntiSpam and Delivery team, where you will help build the systems that detect spam and abuse and deliver billions of messages a day. At IC3, what you need to accomplish is clear; how to accomplish it often is not. You will work under minimal guidance, make decisions independently, review code and give constructive feedback, and create technical designs with simplicity in mind. What You Will Do Build and operate distributed systems for inbound protection, entity reputation, traffic shaping, and message delivery. Use AI-assisted development tools as part of your daily workflow, validating and refining what they produce rather than accepting it blindly. Translate defined technical requirements into correct, readable, testable code, and deploy continuously to production. Troubleshoot software failures and tune performance across high-throughput services. Design and simplify existing components under minimal guidance. Review peers' code, give constructive feedback, and help with estimation. Proficiency with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Codex, with sound judgment over correctness, security, and maintainability. 3+ years of backend-focused software development experience in Java, Go, or C++ (we are primarily a Java team, with some systems in Go). Solid understanding of cloud computing concepts: IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS. Machine learning knowledge with some hands-on AI coding experience. Experience with a public cloud (GCP or AWS). Experience with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes), preferably on GCP. Experience designing and building high-performing, complex server applications on Unix/Linux. Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills, including performance tuning. A clear communicator who enjoys helping people and stays constructive under pressure. Preferred Qualifications Strong understanding of network programming and client/server architecture. Familiarity with best practices for cloud security, scalability, and performance optimization. Professional experience with high-availability, high-throughput distributed systems. Experience with big data technologies such as Hadoop, HBase, and Spark. Experience in algorithm design and ML/AI. Experience with queuing and streaming technologies such as Kafka or Apache Storm. Experience with databases such as PostgreSQL. Working knowledge of a scripting language such as Python, Perl, or Ruby. Knowledge of Scrum and Agile methodologies. Own and maintain the product backlog (features/user stories), including prioritization, refinement, and alignment to business value and capacity. Lead discovery and solution shaping for S2C and P2P initiatives; drive decisions across process standardization vs. local variation. Drive AI and automation initiatives across S2C and P2P to improve user experience, increase compliance, reduce cycle times, and enable touchless processing (e.g., workflow automation, intelligent intake, guided buying, PO/PR/invoice automation, and spend/supplier insights). Act as the project functional/technical lead for implementations, rollouts, and major enhancements (global/regional), coordinating requirements, design, testing, cutover, and adoption. Lead cross-functional workshops to define future-state processes and confirm impacts across Procurement, Finance/AP, and upstream/downstream systems. Manage functional risks, dependencies, and scope trade-offs; ensure delivery quality and readiness. Own end-to-end requirements: business requirements, functional specifications, process flows, control requirements, and acceptance criteria. Design and standardize processes across:S2C: sourcing events, supplier onboarding/qualification, supplier lifecycle management, contract authoring/approvals, contract repository, and compliance workflows. P2P: catalogs/guided buying, requisitioning, approvals, PO lifecycle, receiving, invoicing, matching, exceptions, and supplier enablement. Ensure solutions support auditability and key controls (e.g., approval traceability, delegation, tolerance rules, segregation of duties, retention). Provide functional oversight for configuration of Ariba (or similar) modules and related workflows, catalogs, and supplier enablement settings. Lead functional definition for integrations between the S2P suite and multiple ERPs (SAP, Infor, QAD, JDE), including: Supplier/master data synchronization and POs, receipts, invoices, status updates and exceptions Partner with integration teams (iPaaS/ESB/API) and data/BI teams to validate mappings, reconciliation, and reporting needs (spend, compliance, operational KPIs). Typical Systems & Modules in Scope S2C: sourcing, supplier lifecycle/onboarding, contract lifecycle management (CLM), approvals, compliance P2P: catalogs/guided buying, requisitions, approvals, PO management, receiving, invoicing/e-invoicing, matching, exceptions ERP integration: SAP, Infor, QAD, JDE (multi-ERP operating model) Reporting: spend analytics, compliance, cycle time, exception, aging Integration protocols: APIs, EDI, cXML, ETL processes The Person: You love to learn and grow and be acknowledged for your valuable contributions. You’re not intimidated by innovation. Wouldn’t it be great if you could do your job and do a world of good? In fact, you embrace it. You also have: Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or equivalent experience. 8+ years of functional/technical experience sitting at the intersection of enterprise business system analysis and tech procurement pipelines supporting enterprise applications. 2+ years Low-Code/No-Code hands-on experience building, deploying, and maintaining production-ready low-code applications and automated workflows Hands-on experience with S2P Platforms like SAP Ariba/GEP/Coupa/Ivalua or similar platforms across S2C and/or P2P modules. Experience integrating S2P tools with SAP, Infor, QAD, and/or JD Edwards (including master data and transactional flows). Familiarity with agile delivery and tooling (Jira/Azure DevOps) and ITSM (ServiceNow). Experience with global template design, regional rollouts, and change management/adoption. Strong SQL/data validation skills and familiarity with BI tools (Power BI/Tableau). Strong experience translating business needs into epics/features/user stories and functional specifications. Proven leadership in testing and release readiness (UAT leadership, defect triage, go-live/hypercare).
