Résumé du poste L’ Analyste du transport est responsable de la gestion de bout en bout, de l’optimisation et de la gouvernance des activités de transport qui soutiennent la division Solutions technologiques de McKesson. La personne titulaire du poste agit à titre d’experte en matière pour le transport au sein de l’organisation et assume la responsabilité du transport entrant et sortant, des installations, des relocalisations, de la logistique des salons professionnels, de la conformité douanière, de la gestion des transporteurs, de l’optimisation du fret, de l’exécution de la stratégie de transport et du rendement budgétaire du transport. En collaboration avec l’Analyste associé senior du transport, la personne titulaire du poste gère de façon autonome les activités de transport, élabore et tient à jour les normes de transport, mène des initiatives d’amélioration continue et collabore avec les parties prenantes internes ainsi qu’avec les partenaires logistiques externes afin d’assurer des services de transport rentables, conformes, évolutifs et de grande qualité. Le poste fournit des analyses, un leadership opérationnel et des recommandations stratégiques visant à améliorer le rendement du transport, la satisfaction de la clientèle et l’efficacité globale de la chaîne d’approvisionnement. Section A - Principales responsabilités Gestion des activités de transport (25 %) Gérer tous les volets des activités de transport, notamment les expéditions entrantes et sortantes, les services de messagerie, les envois LTL, les chargements complets, les services de livraison sur mesure, les installations, les relocalisations et les expéditions internationales. Veiller à ce que les expéditions respectent les exigences en matière de service à la clientèle, de qualité, de réglementation et de livraison. Surveiller les délais de transport et intervenir de façon proactive en cas de risque ou de perturbation du service. Coordonner les exigences logistiques liées aux installations chez les clients, aux déménagements de bureaux, aux déploiements d’équipement et aux projets spéciaux. Agir comme principal point d’escalade pour les enjeux opérationnels liés au transport. Veiller à ce que les activités de transport soient exécutées conformément aux politiques de McKesson, aux normes de qualité et aux exigences réglementaires. Stratégie de transport, gouvernance des transporteurs et gestion des partenaires logistiques (20 %) Assumer la responsabilité de la stratégie de transport de Solutions technologiques McKesson et veiller à ce que les capacités de transport soutiennent la croissance de l’entreprise, l’expérience client, l’efficacité opérationnelle, l’atténuation des risques et les objectifs de coûts. Élaborer et exécuter des plans d’optimisation du transport axés sur le rendement du service, l’efficacité du réseau, l’évolutivité et la réduction des coûts de transport. Établir des processus de gouvernance des transporteurs, notamment des fiches de rendement, des revues d’affaires trimestrielles, le suivi des niveaux de service, des plans de mesures correctives et des initiatives d’amélioration continue. Gérer les relations avec les fournisseurs de transport, les courtiers en douane, les transitaires, les fournisseurs d’entreposage et les partenaires logistiques tiers. Diriger les initiatives d’approvisionnement en transport, les appels d’offres de transport, les renouvellements de contrats et les activités de sélection des partenaires de transport. Participer aux négociations de contrats de transport et formuler des recommandations quant à la sélection des transporteurs. Évaluer et recommander des changements au réseau de transport, des stratégies d’acheminement, des possibilités d’optimisation des modes et des solutions logistiques de rechange. Veiller à ce que les fournisseurs tiers respectent les normes de McKesson en matière de qualité, de sécurité, de conformité et de service à la clientèle. Gestion du rendement du transport et responsabilité budgétaire (15 %) Assumer la responsabilité des rapports sur le rendement du transport, notamment les indicateurs clés de rendement, les tableaux de bord, les fiches de rendement des transporteurs, les mesures de service et l’analyse des dépenses de transport. Élaborer les prévisions budgétaires annuelles du transport et soutenir la planification du transport à long terme. Surveiller les dépenses de transport par rapport au budget et repérer les risques, les tendances, les écarts et les possibilités d’économies. Diriger les revues des dépenses de transport et formuler des recommandations visant à améliorer l’efficience des coûts tout en respectant les engagements en matière de service et envers la clientèle. Présenter à la direction le rendement du transport, l’état du budget, les tendances de coûts et les recommandations d’amélioration. Repérer les lacunes opérationnelles et diriger l’élaboration de plans de mesures correctives afin d’améliorer le service, les coûts, la qualité, la conformité et l’efficacité du transport. Soutenir la planification des activités en fournissant des estimations de coûts de transport et des recommandations logistiques pour les initiatives stratégiques. Conformité commerciale, douanes et logistique internationale (15 %) Assumer la responsabilité des activités de conformité liées aux douanes, aux droits, aux importations et aux exportations. Développer et maintenir une expertise en matière de réglementation du transport international, d’Incoterms, de documentation douanière et d’exigences commerciales. Coordonner les expéditions transfrontalières et les activités de transport international concernant le Canada, les États-Unis, l’Europe et d’autres destinations internationales. Veiller au respect de toutes les exigences applicables en matière de transport, de douanes, de réglementation et de politiques d’entreprise. Gérer, au besoin, les relations avec les courtiers en douane et les organismes de réglementation. Soutenir les audits internes et externes liés au transport et à la conformité commerciale. Programmes logistiques spécialisés (15 %) Gérer le soutien en transport et en logistique pour les salons professionnels, les démonstrations, les événements clients, les installations et les déploiements d’équipement spécialisé. Coordonner les exigences de transport avec les équipes de la Gestion des produits, des Ventes, de l’Approvisionnement, des Opérations clients et de l’Entrepôt. Soutenir les mouvements de stocks et les activités logistiques liés aux initiatives d’affaires stratégiques. Veiller à ce que l’équipement soit livré, installé, relocalisé et retourné conformément aux exigences opérationnelles et aux exigences des clients. Amélioration continue et leadership de projet (10 %) Diriger des initiatives d’amélioration continue liées au transport et axées sur la qualité du service, l’expérience client, l’efficacité opérationnelle, la conformité et la réduction des coûts. Établir et tenir à jour les processus, les normes, les procédures opérationnelles normalisées (PON) et les pratiques exemplaires en matière de transport. Évaluer les mesures de rendement du transport et les références sectorielles afin de repérer les possibilités d’amélioration. Diriger des projets interfonctionnels auxquels participent la Chaîne d’approvisionnement, l’Approvisionnement, les Finances, les Opérations, le Service à la clientèle, les Ventes et la Gestion des produits. Évaluer les technologies émergentes en transport, les systèmes de gestion du transport (TMS) et les solutions logistiques. Diriger les activités de mise en œuvre liées aux améliorations des systèmes de transport et des processus opérationnels. Promouvoir une culture d’excellence opérationnelle et d’exécution bien du premier coup (Right First Time). Section B - Exigences principales Formation Baccalauréat ou diplôme d’études collégiales en gestion de la chaîne d’approvisionnement, en logistique, en transport, en administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe. Une certification professionnelle CITT, CSCMP, APICS, PMP ou l’équivalent est considérée comme un atout. Expérience De 4 à 8 ans d’expérience progressive en transport, en logistique ou en chaîne d’approvisionnement. Expérience de la gestion d’activités de transport nationales et internationales. Expérience en conformité douanière, en importation et exportation ainsi qu’en réglementation du transport. Expérience de la gestion de fournisseurs de transport, de courtiers en douane, de transitaires et de partenaires logistiques. Expérience de l’élaboration de stratégies de transport, de la gestion des dépenses de transport et de la direction d’initiatives d’amélioration des processus. Expérience démontrée dans la gestion autonome des priorités opérationnelles et dans l’influence auprès de parties prenantes interfonctionnelles. Section C - Connaissances et compétences Connaissance approfondie des activités de transport, de la gestion du fret, de la conformité douanière et des processus de la chaîne d’approvisionnement. Compréhension approfondie des Incoterms, de la réglementation sur l’importation et l’exportation, des droits de douane et de la logistique internationale. Solide connaissance de l’approvisionnement en transporteurs, des contrats de transport, de l’optimisation du fret et de la budgétisation du transport. Capacités avancées d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes. Compétences intermédiaires à avancées en Microsoft Excel et expérience avec Salesforce, Power BI ou d’autres outils d���intelligence d’affaires. Solides compétences en gestion de projet, en organisation et en gestion des parties prenantes. Capacité démontrée à collaborer et à travailler en équipe, tout en étant en mesure de travailler de façon autonome et de prendre des décisions opérationnelles et commerciales judicieuses. Excellentes aptitudes à communiquer, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit. Capacité d’influencer les parties prenantes et de mener le changement sans autorité directe. Excellentes compétences en anglais, à l’oral et à l’écrit, pour communiquer avec les fournisseurs des États-Unis et d’outre-mer. **************************** Job Summary The Transportation Analyst is responsible for the end-to-end management, optimization, and governance of transportation operations supporting McKesson Technology Solutions. The role serves as the organization's transportation subject matter expert and is accountable for inbound and outbound transportation, installations, relocations, trade show logistics, customs compliance, carrier management, freight optimization, transportation strategy execution, and transportation budget performance. Together with the Sr. Associate Transportation Analyst, the incumbent independently manages transportation activities, develops and maintains transportation standards, drives continuous improvement initiatives, and collaborates with internal stakeholders and external logistics partners to ensure cost-effective, compliant, scalable, and high-quality transportation services. The role provides analytical insight, operational leadership, and strategic recommendations to improve transportation performance, customer satisfaction, and overall supply chain efficiency. Section A – Key Responsibilities Transportation Operations Management (25%) Manage all aspects of transportation operations including inbound, outbound, courier, LTL, truckload, white-glove, installation, relocation, and international shipments. Ensure shipments meet customer service, quality, regulatory, and delivery requirements. Monitor transportation lead times and proactively address service risks or disruptions. Coordinate logistics requirements associated with customer installations, office relocations, equipment deployments, and special projects. Act as the primary escalation point for transportation-related operational issues. Ensure transportation activities are executed in accordance with McKesson policies, quality standards, and regulatory requirements. Transportation Strategy, Carrier Governance and Logistics Partner Management (20%) Own the transportation strategy for McKesson Technology Solutions, ensuring transportation capabilities support business growth, customer experience, operational efficiency, risk mitigation, and cost objectives. Develop and execute transportation optimization plans focused on service performance, network efficiency, scalability, and freight cost reduction. Establish carrier governance processes, including performance scorecards, quarterly business reviews, service-level monitoring, corrective action plans, and continuous improvement initiatives. Manage relationships with transportation providers, customs brokers, freight forwarders, warehousing providers, and third-party logistics partners. Lead carrier sourcing initiatives, transportation RFPs, contract renewals, and transportation partner selection activities. Participate in transportation contract negotiations and recommend carrier selection decisions. Evaluate and recommend transportation network changes, routing strategies, mode optimization opportunities, and alternative logistics solutions. Ensure third-party providers operate in accordance with McKesson quality, safety, compliance, and customer service standards. Transportation Performance Management and Budget Ownership (15%) Own transportation performance reporting, including KPIs, dashboards, carrier scorecards, service metrics, and freight spend analysis. Develop annual transportation budget forecasts and support long-range transportation planning. Monitor transportation expenditures against budget and identify risks, trends, variances, and cost-saving opportunities. Lead freight spend reviews and provide recommendations to improve cost efficiency while maintaining service and customer commitments. Present transportation performance, budget status, cost trends, and improvement recommendations to leadership. Identify operational gaps and lead development of corrective action plans to improve service, cost, quality, compliance, and transportation efficiency. Support business planning by providing transportation cost estimates and logistics recommendations for strategic initiatives. Trade Compliance, Customs and International Logistics (15%) Own customs, duty, import, and export compliance activities. Develop and maintain expertise related to international transportation regulations, Incoterms, customs documentation, and trade requirements. Coordinate cross-border shipments and international transportation activities involving Canada, the United States, Europe, and other international destinations. Ensure compliance with all applicable transportation, customs, regulatory, and corporate requirements. Manage relationships with customs brokers and regulatory agencies as required. Support internal and external audits related to transportation and trade compliance. Specialized Logistics Programs (15%) Manage transportation and logistics support for trade shows, demonstrations, customer events, installations, and specialized equipment deployments. Coordinate transportation requirements with Product Management, Sales, Procurement, Customer Operations, and Warehouse teams. Support inventory movements and logistics activities associated with strategic business initiatives. Ensure equipment is delivered, installed, relocated, and returned in accordance with operational and customer requirements. Continuous Improvement and Project Leadership (10%) Lead transportation-related continuous improvement initiatives focused on service quality, customer experience, operational efficiency, compliance, and cost reduction. Establish and maintain transportation processes, standards, SOPs, and best practices. Evaluate transportation metrics and industry benchmarks to identify improvement opportunities. Lead cross-functional projects involving Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Operations, Customer Service, Sales, and Product Management. Evaluate emerging transportation technologies, transportation management systems (TMS), and logistics solutions. Lead implementation activities associated with transportation system enhancements and operational process improvements. Promote a culture of operational excellence and Right First Time execution. Section B – Key Requirements Education Bachelor's Degree or College Diploma in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Transportation, Business Administration, or a related field. CITT, CSCMP, APICS, PMP, or equivalent professional certification considered an asset. Experience 4 to 8 years of progressive transportation, logistics, or supply chain experience. Experience managing domestic and international transportation operations. Experience with customs compliance, import/export activities, and transportation regulations. Experience managing transportation providers, customs brokers, freight forwarders, and logistics partners. Experience developing transportation strategies, managing freight spend, and leading process improvement initiatives. Proven experience independently managing operational priorities and influencing cross-functional stakeholders. Section C – Knowledge and Skills Advanced knowledge of transportation operations, freight management, customs compliance, and supply chain processes. In-depth understanding of Incoterms, import/export regulations, customs duties, and international logistics. Strong knowledge of carrier sourcing, transportation contracts, freight optimization, and transportation budgeting. Advanced analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience with Salesforce, Power BI, or other business intelligence tools. Strong project management, organizational, and stakeholder management skills. Proven ability to be a team player and work in a team environment, but also able to work independently and make sound operational and business decisions. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to influence stakeholders and drive change without direct authority. Strong English communication skills (verbal and written) for communicating with US & overseas suppliers. newJobs.descriptionText: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. Xometry is looking for a Staff Cloud Security Engineer to own our cloud security posture and runtime detection capabilities. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role focused on ensuring our live cloud environments and containerized workloads are hardened, continuously monitored, and generating the right signals for our security operations function. This role is about detection architecture, posture management, and runtime visibility. You will be the primary owner of our CrowdStrike platform, working closely with our MDR providers to ensure alert fidelity, tuning, and appropriate escalation. You will also evaluate and potentially implement a cloud SIEM. This isn’t a role where you watch dashboards and write tickets. You’ll be the person who defines how we detect threats, decides how we respond to them, and has the autonomy to fix what you find. If you’re tired of maintaining legacy tooling, navigating slow change management processes, or writing findings that disappear into a backlog, this is the opposite of that. We’re a SaaS-first company running a modern, cloud-native stack. We ship fixes, not tickets. What You'll Contribute Own CrowdStrike Falcon configuration, ensuring policies are appropriately scoped, tuned, and generating actionable alerts. Partner with MDR to define alert routing, triage thresholds, and escalation logic, ensuring the right signals reach the right team. Monitor cloud environments (primarily AWS) for security posture drift: misconfigured IAM roles, overly permissive security groups, exposed storage, and non-compliant resource configurations. Secure Kubernetes clusters and containerized workloads: manage Network Policies, RBAC, Admission Controllers, and runtime detection for anomalous container behavior. Develop and enforce cloud security policies and standards for AWS infrastructure, ensuring secure and scalable deployments align with organizational risk posture. Evaluate and lead the implementation of additional detection tooling, including cloud SIEM platforms, designing detection rules and alerting pipelines. Manage infrastructure as code (IaC) security using Terraform or OpenTofu — ensuring IaC definitions meet security standards before deployment. Automate security posture checks and detection workflows using Python and shell scripting. Stay current with the evolving cloud threat landscape and translate emerging threats into detection coverage or posture improvements. What You Bring Minimum 8 years of experience in cloud security, security engineering, or a related infrastructure security discipline. Hands-on experience with a cloud security posture management (CSPM) platform — CrowdStrike, Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Orca, or equivalent. Prior CrowdStrike experience is a plus but not required. Deep familiarity with AWS security architecture: IAM/SCP policy design, VPC networking, security groups, CloudTrail, and cloud-native security controls. GCP or Azure experience considered in lieu of AWS for strong candidates willing to expand into AWS. Proficiency with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, OpenTofu, or CloudFormation, with an understanding of how to enforce security standards within IaC workflows. Strong Python and shell scripting skills for security automation, detection rule development, and tooling integration. Must be a US Citizen or legal permanent resident (Xometry handles ITAR-controlled data). Preferred AWS GovCloud experience. Hands-on Kubernetes security experience: securing and managing production clusters, including Network Policies, RBAC, and Admission Controllers. Experience with cloud-native SIEM solutions, including writing detection rules in Python or SQL. Experience securing microservices architectures, including service mesh security (Istio or Linkerd). newJobs.descriptionText: Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about http://hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works http://hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals http://www.hims.com/careers-professionals. ABOUT THE ROLE: We're looking for a Principal Data Engineer to be the most senior individual contributor on the Data Platform Engineering (DPE) team at Hims & Hers. In this role, you will define and align the architectural vision for our data platform with business goals – working in close partnership with product, engineering, and data science leadership. Your scope is org-wide: you will set technical direction across every surface DPE owns, drive the highest-stakes architectural decisions, and establish the standards that the entire data engineering discipline operates by. Our platform serves millions of patients across telehealth, prescription, and wellness products. It runs on GCP BigQuery, Airflow on Astronomer/EKS, dbt, Confluent Kafka, Databricks Delta Lake, and Terraform/OpenTofu – and it is in active, consequential evolution: a net-new streaming platform, and a lower environments strategy being built from scratch. You will own those architectural bets. YOU WILL: - Own the long-term technical architecture for DPE across ingestion, orchestration, event streaming, and the platform infrastructure that enables transformation and serving - driving the highest-stakes decisions for the CDC-based streaming platform (Kafka → Flink → BigQuery), orchestration platform evaluation, and lower environment strategy - Chair Architecture Review Committee (ARC) decisions; act as the primary technical DRI for cross-team, multi-system, and cost-impacting changes - Establish and enforce engineering standards and production readiness criteria across all DPE-owned systems - testing requirements, CI/CD patterns, observability-as-code, logging standards, data contracts, Schema Registry governance, and what 'production-ready' means for emerging streaming and CDC capabilities - Own data quality and observability architecture - dbt anomaly detection frameworks, schema validation, data drift alerting, and the platform standards that ensure consumers can trust the data they build on - Define the technical strategy for self-service analytics: what platform capabilities enable Analytics Engineering to work independently, what guardrails prevent downstream breakage, and how DPE reduces its bottleneck over time - Own evaluation, onboarding, and ongoing governance of DPE-managed tooling - Fivetran, Confluent, and equivalent platforms, including contract management, cost tracking, and deprecation decisions - Own data sharing and egress patterns - access provisioning, cross-team data contracts, reverse ETL (Hightouch), and governed consumption paths for internal and external consumers - Drive cost governance for platform infrastructure - BigQuery slot reservations, query optimization, partition strategies, orchestration rightsizing, and cloud spend accountability across the full DPE stack - Lead incident response for platform-level P1/P2 incidents: act as technical escalation point, facilitate blameless RCAs, and drive systemic fixes that prevent recurrence - Produce exemplary technical artifacts - architecture decision records, solution design docs, RFCs - that create alignment and become the team's reference standard - Mentor and elevate Staff and Senior Data Engineers; raise the technical ceiling through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on pairing - Partner cross-functionally with ML/Data Science, legal/security/compliance, and DevOps to deliver platform capabilities that are ML-ready, compliant with HIPAA/GDPR, and hardened at the infrastructure layer - Contribute hands-on to critical path work YOU HAVE: - 15+ years of professional experience designing, building, and owning data platform architecture at company scale - Demonstrated ability to define and align architectural vision with business goals across an entire engineering organization - Deep expertise in cloud-native data platforms across GCP primary (BigQuery, GCS, Dataflow); AWS operational familiarity required (EKS-based Airflow) - BigQuery strongly preferred; multi-cloud fluency is required, not a plus - Hands-on experience with the modern data stack: experience governing dbt at platform scale, Airflow/Astronomer, Kafka/Confluent, Databricks/Spark, Fivetran, and data sharing/activation platforms (Hightouch or equivalent) - Experience designing and operating event streaming pipelines at scale - including Schema Registry, data contracts, and consumer lag management - Proven track record establishing engineering standards across multiple teams and driving adoption without direct authority - Experience owning data quality frameworks - dbt testing, anomaly detection, schema validation, and data observability tooling - Experience with data governance and compliance frameworks in a regulated environment - HIPAA/PHI handling, data classification, access controls, audit logging, and GDPR - Experience leading incident response for data platform outages - blameless RCA, systemic root cause identification, and operational improvement - Infrastructure-as-code fluency - Terraform or equivalent; you treat infrastructure changes like software changes - Strong Python and SQL skills; comfortable writing, reviewing, and raising the bar on production-grade pipeline code - Clear written communication: you produce design docs and RFCs that build alignment, not confusion. Comfort operating in ambiguity - you define the path, you don't wait for it to be defined PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: - Databricks, Unity Catalog, and Delta Lake in production at scale - Experience with CDC (Change Data Capture) patterns and Flink for real-time data processing - PySpark/SparkSQL for large-scale batch and streaming workloads - Experience driving a BigQuery → Databricks Lakehouse migration or equivalent cloud data warehouse migration - Experience with MLOps - partnering with ML engineers on model training pipelines, feature stores, and experimentation infrastructure - Go or Python service development for Kafka producers and consumers - Experience at a direct-to-consumer healthcare or telehealth company with HIPAA and GDPR obligations - Familiarity with SOX compliance controls in a data engineering context OUR BENEFITS (THERE ARE MORE BUT HERE ARE SOME HIGHLIGHTS): - Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles - Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days - Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave - Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP) - 401k benefits with employer matching contribution - Offsite team retreats We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. newJobs.descriptionText: Über uns Slalom ist ein modernes Beratungsunternehmen, das sich auf Strategie, Technologie und IT-Transformation konzentriert. In acht Ländern und 49 Offices auf der ganzen Welt haben unsere Berater:innen die Möglichkeit, nach dem lokalen Ansatz schnell bei unseren Kunden zu sein und vor Ort zu helfen. Slalom wurde 2001 gegründet, hat seinen Hauptsitz in Seattle und ist organisch auf über 12.000 Mitarbeitende gewachsen. Slalom wurde acht Jahre in Folge von Fortune zu einem der 100 besten Arbeitgeber ernannt und wird regelmäßig von seinen Mitarbeitenden als bester Arbeitsplatz ausgezeichnet. Das sind deine täglichen Aufgaben Du planst, entwickelst und lieferst Softwarekomponenten und Cloud-Infrastrukturen für Kundenprojekte, von der Anforderungsdefinition bis zum erfolgreichen Deployment CI/CD-Pipelines und Automatisierung sind dein Tagesgeschäft, wobei du durch Code Reviews und Best Practices stets eine hohe Qualität und Stabilität sicherstellst AI-Tools wie GitHub Copilot, Claude oder Codex setzt du gezielt ein, um effizienter zu arbeiten und innovative Lösungen für Kunden und interne Prozesse zu entwickeln Du arbeitest eng mit multidisziplinären Teams zusammen, übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in technische Lösungen und coachst Kolleg:innen sowohl in Kundenprojekten als auch in internen Initiativen Die Weiterentwicklung von Slalom liegt dir am Herzen, du bringst dich aktiv in die Verbesserung interner Prozesse ein und stärkst unsere technische Community Das bringst du mit Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang sowie mind. 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung, idealerweise mit einem Einstieg im Software Engineering und einer zunehmenden Spezialisierung im Bereich DevOps und Platform Engineering Dein technisches Toolkit umfasst gängige DevOps-Tools wie GitLab, GitHub, Terraform, etc. Du weißt, wie man sie effektiv einsetzt, und hast fundierte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Azure oder Google Cloud Platform Erste Kenntnisse in Observability-Tools wie Grafana, Datadog oder New Relic sind ein willkommenes Plus Du hast bereits fortgeschrittene Erfahrungen im Deployment und in der Arbeit mit AI-gestützten Tools wie GitHub Copilot, Codex oder Claude gesammelt und nutzt sie aktiv, um effizienter zu arbeiten Delivery ist deine Antriebskraft, du denkst lösungsorientiert, übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse und bringst eine hands-on Mentalität mit, die dich motiviert, Dinge voranzutreiben und abzuschließen Du verfügst über sehr gute Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch (min. C1-Level) Deine Benefits Hybrides Arbeiten im Home Office und in unseren modernen Offices in den Herzen von München, Düsseldorf oder Frankfurt am Main Bis zu 30 Tage Arbeiten im Ausland nach Absprache jährlich möglich 30 Tage Urlaub und die Möglichkeit des Erwerbs von bis zu zehn zusätzlichen Urlaubstagen pro Jahr Eine monatliche individuelle Mobilitätspauschale für private Reisen mit der Bahn, Auto, Flugzeug, Rad, Tank- oder Werkstattkosten Monatliche Smartphonepauschale von 100€ (Brutto) und freie Wahl deines Laptops (Apple oder HP) Mit deiner Mitgliedschaft bei EGYM Wellpass hast du Zugang zu über 2.800 Sport-, Fitness- und Wellnesseinrichtungen sowie zu Apps und Home Workouts Jährliches Budget von rund 300€ für dein Well-being. Ob Yoga, Fitnesskurs, Massage oder doch einer Spende für einen guten Zweck, du entscheidest Wir kümmern uns um deine Zukunft – mit einer jährlichen Zahlung in unseren Pensionsfond (4% des Grundgehalts) Zwei Impact Days für Volunteering in deiner Community pro Jahr Du bist uns wichtig – neben Coaching und weiteren Unterstützungsprogrammen bieten wir umfangreiche Versicherungspläne für dich und deine Familie an Regelmäßige Teamevents, Get together und Lunch & Learns mit den besten Kollegen:innen in unseren zentralen Offices Was uns ausmacht Unsere zehn „Slalom Core Values“ sind ein fester Bestandteil von allem, was wir bei Slalom tun, und prägen unsere mitarbeiterzentrierte Kultur. Wir fördern die Vielfalt am Arbeitsplatz und stellen sicher, dass alle unsere Mitarbeitenden ihr Potenzial voll entfalten können, unabhängig von ihrem persönlichen, kulturellen und sozialen Background. Wir bauen Teams auf, die die Vielfalt der Communities widerspiegeln, für die wir arbeiten. Come as you are! Deshalb Slalom Obwohl Slalom schon seit 2001 ein globaler Player ist, befinden wir uns in einer für unsere Branche besonderen Ausgangslage und werden nach wie vor von unseren Gründern geführt. Dies bedeutet konkret, dass unsere Ziele nicht von externen Stakeholder:innen getrieben werden, sondern stets die Mitarbeitenden und unsere Kunden im Vordergrund stehen. Unser Ziel ist es, unsere Kunden mit allen nötigen Skills auszustatten, damit diese vollumfänglich hinter ihrer Reise in die Cloud stehen und nach dem erfolgreichen Abschluss der gemeinsamen Projekte diese Veränderung eigenständig und nachhaltig leben. Man könnte fast sagen: „wir kommen, um zu gehen“. Milestones Mehr als 12.000 Slalomer:innen. Acht Länder. 45 Standorte. Und stetiges, schnelles Wachstum. In Deutschland haben wir unseren ersten Standort 2022 in München eröffnet, Düsseldorf und Frankfurt folgten in den Jahren 2023 und 2024. Das Team ist auf über 170 Mitarbeiter:innen angewachsen und wird sich auch in den nächsten Jahren stetig vergrößern. Wenn du dich angesprochen fühlst, freuen wir uns von dir zu hören!

newJobs.descriptionText: Who You’ll Work With At Slalom, we co-create custom software, data and cloud products with clients who are ready to accelerate their digital transformation. We're passionate about technology, compelled by its potential as we help create the digital products, experiences, and technology-driven organizations that drive true change. We’re thrilled by the opportunity to build the future we want to see, with anyone willing to join us. Slalom Cloud-Build’s Quality Engineering (QE) discipline brings a modern approach to software quality, playing a critical role in high-velocity software engineering teams. We work with current and emerging tools and techniques to help build reliable, scalable software. Our expertise in software quality principles and techniques enables key principles of whole-team ownership of quality, close proximity of software development and test activities, and reliable, scalable test automation. Our capability is comprised of passionate, flexible technologists who love to practice and hone their craft. As tools evolve and technologies emerge, we work to stay in front of innovation in automated software development and delivery. We work in cross-functional teams to build full-stack solutions across a range of established and emerging technologies and techniques, including: Front end applications targeting native mobile and modern web platforms. Examples include React, Native iOS/Android, and Vue. APIs and back-end services built using emerging frameworks and architectural patterns. Examples include microservices, Node, Typescript, Java and .Net. Hosting and application services provided by industry leading cloud providers. Examples include AWS, Azure and GCP. Data Engineering applications for real-time data solutions, data platforms, visualization, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. Operational efficiencies leveraging modern ecosystems and automated build and deployment pipelines. Collaborative build practices that allow our teams to be agile and responsive to our clients’ needs. We are looking for candidates who are interested in working in a hybrid environment as we build the foundation and grow our team in Medellin and Bogota. We offer a flexible working environment to balance the need to work independently, with days that may require in-person collaboration at our office. What You’ll Do As a Senior Engineer, you will bring your expertise in software quality techniques and tools to a collaborative, team based environment. You will dive into the technical details, collaborating to design an optimal testing approach. You will work across multiple tech stacks and implement automation using a variety of tools. As a champion of quality, you will enable the team to maintain and improve velocity. Your growing experience and learning mindset enable you to take on a variety of new challenges and establish areas of expertise. You will have opportunities to share your knowledge and help us continually elevate the Quality Engineering discipline. Specifically, you will: Develop and evolve test plans for complex applications Deconstruct solutions into tests that optimize for coverage and risk Create trusted test automation with high reliability and relevancy Extend test automation frameworks to incorporate new functionality Assess and advise on testability of user stories, including acceptance criteria, non-functional requirements, and the definition of done. Share what you learn with your teams and the other members of the QE community What You’ll Bring As a Senior Engineer in the Quality Engineering discipline, you are experienced with working in an Agile team-based environment, and you consistently add velocity to the team. You confidently use code to build reliable, trusted test automation. You help define clear acceptance criteria, facilitate defect triage, and produce quality metrics. You possess an inquisitive, exploratory mindset, combined with strong test planning, communication, and organizational skills. You may have built deep expertise in a particular area of modern software quality, or you may have a breadth of experience across technology solutions. Your learning mindset enables you to take on new challenges to expand and deepen your skills across a wide variety of technology stacks. A computer science-based mindset is needed; a technology-based education is helpful. About Us Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact. What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.

newJobs.descriptionText: About TailorCare TailorCare is transforming the experience of specialty care. Our comprehensive care program takes a profoundly personal, evidence-based approach to improving patient outcomes for joint, back, and muscle conditions. By carefully assessing patients' symptoms, health histories, preferences, and goals with predictive data and the latest evidence-based guidelines, we help patients choose and navigate the most effective treatment pathway for them every step of the way. TailorCare values the experiences and perspectives of individuals from all backgrounds. We are a highly collaborative, curious, and determined team passionate about scaling a high-growth start-up to improve the lives of those in pain. TailorCare is a remote-first company with our corporate office located in Nashville. About the Role As a Care Advocate, you will be responsible for engaging prospective patients through proactive outbound calls and multichannel outreach to drive awareness and enrollment in TailorCare’s musculoskeletal (MSK) care navigation program. You’ll often serve as the first point of contact, guiding patients through the value of our services and creating a personalized, empathetic, and compelling experience. This is a high-volume, outbound call center role focused on healthcare engagement, where you will connect with patients and their caregivers to identify barriers and motivate them to take action toward improved musculoskeletal (MSK) care. This is a non-exempt (hourly) position. Location & Schedule This is a 100% remote role. Candidates must be available to work hours aligned with Eastern, Central, or Mountain Time Zones. Responsibilities Conduct high-volume outbound calls and multichannel outreach (phone, SMS, email) to eligible patients to introduce TailorCare’s services and support program enrollment. Build and maintain a working knowledge of TailorCare’s MSK program, including core conditions, care pathways, eligibility criteria, and the enrollment process, to explain the program clearly and accurately. Clearly and empathetically communicate TailorCare’s value proposition, tailoring the conversation to patient goals, health literacy, concerns, and motivations. Build trust and rapport quickly using active listening, genuine empathy, and a compassionate approach that puts patients at ease and encourages engagement. Develop and apply foundational motivational interviewing (MI) techniques — including open-ended questioning, affirmations, reflective listening, and summarizing — to support patient-centered conversations. Identify and address common patient questions, barriers, or objections using established techniques while maintaining a calm, supportive tone; seek guidance and escalate appropriately when patient needs or situations fall outside your scope. Demonstrate empathy, professionalism, and consistency across all patient interactions, representing TailorCare’s values and mission. Document all patient interactions accurately, thoroughly, and in a timely manner within internal systems to support care coordination, data integrity, and reporting. Meet or exceed performance targets related to outreach volume, patient engagement, caseload management, and call quality. Use personal performance data and coaching feedback to identify trends in your own outreach and drive continuous self-improvement. Use AI-enabled tools and new technologies with curiosity, openness, and responsibility to improve personal productivity and outreach effectiveness. Adapt to changing scripts, tools, and workflows with a positive, growth-oriented mindset. Coordinate patient handoffs with internal care teams. Participate in regular team meetings and daily standups, contributing to a positive, inclusive culture of learning and collaboration. Surface observations, feedback, and ideas on patient trends, outreach barriers, or script effectiveness to appropriate team members for continuous improvement. Perform other duties as assigned. Qualifications Required: Experience in outbound call center, inside sales, telephonic outreach, or patient engagement roles—preferably in a healthcare, health plan, or health tech environment. Strong written and verbal communication, persuasion, and active listening skills. Willingness to learn and apply motivational interviewing techniques in patient conversations. Ability to manage a high call volume while maintaining accuracy and empathy. Comfortable working with productivity targets and quality metrics in a fast-paced, tech-enabled environment. Ability to use personal performance data and feedback to drive self-improvement. High comfort level with technology, including contact center platforms, CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), documentation tools, and Google Suite. Openness and adaptability to new technologies, including responsible use of AI-enabled tools. Ability to effectively collaborate with multidisciplinary teams. Excellent organizational and prioritization skills. Strong attention to detail. Ability and willingness to travel up to 10% as needed for onsite meetings, team collaboration, and company events. Preferred: Familiarity with motivational interviewing and/or patient coaching strategies. Experience working with Medicare populations and a basic understanding of Medicare Health Plans. Knowledge of medical terminology. Previous experience with remote/telemedicine care delivery. What's In It For You Meaningful Work: We are dedicated to our mission and deeply value our patients and each other. Each day offers the opportunity to make a positive impact. Work Environment: We operate as a remote-first company with options for a hybrid work model in Nashville. Time Off: Our generous paid time off (PTO) and holiday plans ensure you have ample time to rest and recharge. Family First: We offer paid parental leave and support a healthy work-life balance, encouraging flexibility and autonomy. We love talking about our family and pets! Comprehensive Benefits: From Day 1, employees enjoy medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, wellness resources and an employer HSA contribution. Fair Compensation: We are committed to equitable pay for all team members and support your future goals with a 401k plan that includes employer matching. Community: We foster an inclusive environment where you can rely on your teammates, share honest feedback, and feel comfortable being your authentic self at work each day. newJobs.descriptionText: Welcome to the Agentic Commerce Era At Commerce, our mission is to empower businesses to innovate, grow, and thrive with our open, AI-driven commerce ecosystem. We believe in harnessing AI responsibly to unlock new possibilities, and we’re looking for individuals who use it intentionally to solve problems, accelerate outcomes, and expand what’s possible in their role. Our purpose is to help businesses confidently solve complex commerce challenges so they can build smarter, adapt faster, and grow on their own terms. If you want to be part of a team of bold builders, sharp thinkers, and technical trailblazers who shape the future of commerce, this is the place for you. Commerce is seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager to support the Feedonomics platform and drive the evolution of the platform in the agentic era of commerce. This role owns two interconnected strategic pillars: expanding and maturing our API surface area to enable integration with services and AI-powered workflows at scale; and building a next-generation in-platform AI assistant that allows operators to take catalog and channel actions through natural language. The ideal candidate combines deep e-commerce domain knowledge with a strong technical orientation and a genuine interest in how AI agents, MCP servers, and CLI tooling are reshaping how software is built and operated. This role may also carry ownership over additional product areas that make up the Feedonomics solution offering. As a Commerce brand, Feedonomics is a leading product feed management platform that helps brands, retailers, and agencies list and optimize products across top ecommerce channels worldwide. Feedonomics manages everything from onboarding to ongoing feed optimization, enabling our clients to scale faster with less effort. Feedonomics has earned a strong reputation for a full-service model and powerful technology—all rooted in a commitment to excellence. What You’ll Do: Own the strategy and roadmap for Feedonomics’ programmatic access layer, including APIs covering catalog management, data transformation, import/export configuration, etc. Define capability requirements and prioritize the backlog for API surface expansion; translate complex workflows into clear, well-scoped API capabilities Drive developer experience improvements across authentication, error handling, rate-limit design, and documentation so that integration partners and internal tools can build reliably on FDX APIs Lead the product definition for a conversational AI assistant embedded in the Feedonomics platform, enabling users to take targeted catalog management and channel actions through natural language Define and ship the tools (e.g., MCP, CLI) that expose Feedonomics capabilities to AI agents and LLM-powered workflows, including capability descriptions, tool schemas, and safety/permission guardrails Work closely with engineering to define the right level of abstraction for Feedonomics tools to simplify workflows and reduce required API calls Stay current with the evolving agentic ecosystem (MCP, function-calling, agent SDKs) and continuously refine the product strategy based on how customers and partners are adopting these capabilities Lead strategic planning, development, and execution for your product areas end-to-end, including roadmap definition, backlog management in Jira, and sprint-level delivery Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify trends, customer needs, and opportunities in e-commerce technology and the AI tooling landscape Collaborate closely with engineering, design, sales, and customer support to define requirements and priorities grounded in customer outcomes Decompose complex initiatives into iterative deliverables, with each release adding measurable customer value Create comprehensive narratives for Epics and Stories; facilitate planning and grooming sessions to keep teams aligned and unblocked Validate new functionality with platform users and key stakeholders before development; demo features to the organization and customers Define and track metrics that measure the effectiveness of product enhancements; iterate based on data Communicate product strategy, business outcomes, and performance metrics to stakeholders at all levels Who You Are 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years owning platform, API, or developer-facing products Demonstrated track record of defining and shipping API products or developer tools used by external integrators Strong familiarity with the e-commerce technology stack: platforms (Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento), advertising channels (Google, Meta), marketplaces (Amazon, Walmart, eBay), and business systems (PIM, ERP, OMS) Experience working in a fast-paced, startup-like environment with ambiguous, high-stakes problems Technical background or strong technical orientation — comfortable getting into the weeds with engineers on API design, authentication schemes, rate-limit strategy, and data pipeline architecture Familiarity with the emerging agentic AI tooling ecosystem: Model Context Protocol (MCP), LLM function calling, agent SDKs, or similar. You don’t need to have shipped an MCP server, but you understand what they are and why they matter Understanding of the agent harness and orchestration layer — how frameworks wrap LLMs with memory, tools, and execution loops, and why that matters for how external agents will discover and invoke Feedonomics capabilities. You've used AI agents with tool/function calling to complete real workflows Comfort working with REST APIs, reading API documentation, and reasoning about developer ergonomics and integration patterns Skills & Mindset You possess an entrepreneurial mindset, with a bias for customer-centric innovation and a sense of urgency You get excited about tackling big, complicated, and often ambiguous problems — and you bring structure to them You understand that changing user behavior is harder than building features, and you design accordingly You think about APIs as products with two audiences: the developer reading the docs and the AI agent reasoning about the schema. You optimize for both You are a powerful cross-functional influencer — people like working with you even when they disagree with you You possess strong UX instincts and drive the design vision You ask “Why did they build it that way?” and “What would happen if…?” You love trying new things You have excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical audiences You have strong analytical skills and the ability to translate complex requirements into actionable product plans Work Where You Thrive This is a hybrid role. newJobs.descriptionText: It takes powerful technology to connect our brands and partners with an audience of hundreds of millions of people. Whether you’re looking to write mobile app code, engineer the servers behind our massive ad tech stacks, or develop algorithms to help us process trillions of data points a day, what you do here will have a huge impact on our business—and the world. About the Team Identity platforms at Yahoo provide modern, secure identity offerings for consumers and businesses interacting with Yahoo systems. These platforms operate at massive scale, serving hundreds of millions of users every day, and power critical authentication, authorization, and account management capabilities across Yahoo products. As part of Yahoo’s transition to an AI-First engineering model, teams increasingly leverage AI-assisted development environments (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) combined with Spec-Driven Development (SDD) workflows, to accelerate delivery while maintaining high engineering quality. About the Role We are looking for a Full Stack Software Dev Engineer II to join our Identity organization. You will work across the stack to build secure, scalable, and user-friendly authentication and account management experiences that serve hundreds of millions of users globally. In this role, you will work independently with minimal guidance, owning critical features and acting as a technical resource for your peers. A core expectation is the ability to collaborate effectively with AI systems—using structured specs, deep codebase context, and prompt modeling to guide high-quality software implementation. We seek engineers who possess an experimentation-forward mindset and view AI as a force multiplier for architectural excellence and team-wide productivity. Responsibilities Design, build, and operate secure, scalable full-stack identity systems using ReactJS, TypeScript, Java, and Node.js. Own complex features and standalone project phases end-to-end, from gathering requirements and systems design to implementation, testing, and production. Lead an AI-first development workflow within the squad, writing precise markdown specifications to drive AI-assisted code generation (Cursor, Claude Code), and taking responsibility for the rigorous validation, testing, and safety of all generated assets. Identify system bottlenecks, enhance platform reliability, and debug complex production issues in our high-traffic distributed identity systems. Proactively research and implement AI-driven efficiencies in your daily coding workflows, replacing repetitive manual tasks with structured automation, custom templates, and AI-assisted testing. Act as a technical resource for the team by sharing successful prompt engineering patterns, context modeling strategies, and workflow optimizations that level up the overall engineering velocity of the squad. Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Managers, UX Designers, Security Engineers, and other Yahoo product squads to coordinate technical integrations. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 4–6 years of professional full-stack software engineering experience. Strong hands-on engineering experience using Java for robust backend services. Experience building responsive, high-performance web applications using React.js, Node.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as Next.js. Strong core engineering fundamentals in distributed system design, API development, databases, and web security. Demonstrated experience integrating AI-assisted developer tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) into day-to-day software development workflows to build and refactor production-grade systems. Practical understanding of prompt engineering, model limitations, and structured context assembly to generate robust code outputs. Proven capability to evaluate, audit, and debug AI-generated outputs, ensuring alignment with Yahoo’s high standards for code quality, security protocols, and performance. Experience with testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and writing production-ready, highly maintainable tests. Preferred Qualifications Experience building or maintaining high-scale Identity and Access Management (IAM) systems, auth protocols (OAuth, OIDC, SAML), or web security standards. Cloud platform experience (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and infrastructure-as-code. Familiarity with observability tools (Splunk, Grafana) and client/server performance profiling. Experience with structured development methodologies, such as Spec-Driven Development (SDD), API-first design, or AI-assisted diagnostic tools. Exposure to web accessibility (WCAG), internationalization, or large-scale consumer product delivery. What Success Looks Like Consistently deliver high-quality, high-impact features independently, ensuring secure user authentication experiences for hundreds of millions of users. Masterfully leverage AI-assisted tools to significantly compress development lifecycles while maintaining an ultra-high bar for security compliance and test coverage. Raise overall engineering standards by contributing to system architecture discussions, documenting clear technical specifications, and mentoring junior engineers. Accelerate squad velocity by sharing innovative, repeatable ways to integrate AI workflows into daily development, testing, and troubleshooting activities. The material job duties and responsibilities of this role include those listed above as well as adhering to Yahoo policies; exercising sound judgment; working effectively, safely and inclusively with others; exhibiting trustworthiness and meeting expectations; and safeguarding business operations and brand integrity. At Yahoo, we offer flexible hybrid work options that our employees love! While most roles don’t require regular office attendance, you may occasionally be asked to attend in-person events or team sessions. You’ll always get notice to make arrangements. Your recruiter will let you know if a specific job requires regular attendance at a Yahoo office or facility. If you have any questions about how this applies to the role, just ask the recruiter! Yahoo is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

newJobs.descriptionText: Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Success in this role requires strong prospecting skills, disciplined discovery, and the ability to navigate multi-threaded buying groups across both technical and non-technical stakeholders, with a focus on $50k+ ACV opportunities. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Engineers and cross-functional teams to deliver thoughtful, value-based sales motions tailored to each customer’s needs. newJobs.descriptionText: Yahoo Mail is the ultimate consumer inbox with hundreds of millions of users. It’s the best way to access your email and stay organized from a computer, phone or tablet. With its beautiful design and lightning fast speed, Yahoo Mail makes reading, organizing, and sending emails easier than ever. A Little About Us The Mail Intelligence team is the brain behind the inbox. We are responsible for building the next generation of platforms and services that enable Yahoo to deliver deeply personalized, intelligent, and context-aware experiences to hundreds of millions of users globally. We process billions of messages and manage data on a petabyte scale. Using cutting-edge AI algorithms and foundation models, we extract knowledge and interconnect information from diverse sources to simplify our users' lives. Building this knowledge provides many challenges in the areas of natural language processing, machine learning techniques, and petabyte-scale data processing. You will build tools and workflows to make it easier to manage and act on this vast information, applying your insights to build innovative consumer applications for Yahoo Mail. A Lot About You You are a seasoned Applied ML Researcher who thrives at the intersection of theoretical innovation and production-grade execution. You don't just follow the latest LLM trends; you understand the mechanics of transformer architectures and how to optimize them for massive scale. You have expertise working across multiple ML and NLP spaces—including summarization, information extraction, classification, and ranking—at a very large scale. You have hands-on experience with knowledge distillation and believe that a model is only as good as its evaluation framework and low-latency production performance. You combine strong research fundamentals with pragmatic production instincts, comfortably navigating ambiguity to drive high-impact initiatives independently while mentoring and elevating engineering peers. Responsibilities Lead R&D: Drive the research strategy and development of deep learning and generative AI models specifically tailored for large-scale email and communication data. Model Innovation & Optimization: Define and advance approaches for fine-tuning and adapting open-source foundation models using parameter-efficient techniques (LoRA, adapters) and quantization-aware training. Efficiency at Scale: Design and implement knowledge distillation to transfer complex capabilities into smaller, high-performance models operating under strict latency budgets. Modern Evaluation Strategy: Establish and standardize robust evaluation frameworks, including LLM-as-a-judge methodologies, synthetic evaluation datasets, and human-in-the-loop validation. Product Integration: Build repeatable, scalable training and evaluation workflows for high-throughput production environments. AI-Augmented Development Workflow: Integrate AI pair-programming tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor) and automated LLM workflows to accelerate experimental iteration, code generation, and research prototyping. Strategic Future-Proofing: Set technical direction for agent-based systems, tool-use paradigms, and long-term generative AI roadmaps. Technical Mentorship & Governance: Raise the bar for technical excellence by guiding researchers, shaping org-wide AI technical strategy, and establishing best practices for model validation. Qualifications PhD (preferred) or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, NLP, or a related field. 9+ years of hands-on experience in applied machine learning and deep learning, with significant hands-on work in NLP and generative models at scale. Demonstrated experience fine-tuning LLMs using LoRA or other parameter-efficient methods. Experience with knowledge distillation, model compression, and/or training smaller models from larger teacher models. Hands-on experience using LLMs for pseudo-labeling and synthetic data generation to create high-quality training datasets. Experience building and evaluating LLM-based agents, including tool use, multi-agent orchestration, and reasoning workflows. Deep understanding of transformer architectures (encoder-only, decoder-only, encoder-decoder) and modern generative transformer techniques. Experience designing evaluation frameworks for generative systems, including prompt-based evaluation, LLM-as-a-judge approaches, and automated output validation. Hands-on experience incorporating AI pair-programming tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) or LLM workbench environments into daily developer and research workflows. Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, along with Hugging Face tooling. Experience building scalable data pipelines and training workflows for large datasets. Strong experimental rigor and ability to translate research ideas into production-ready systems. Excellent communication skills and ability to operate effectively in cross-functional, fast-moving environments. Preferred Qualifications Experience with large-scale distributed training and inference. Experience building, deploying, and optimizing models for on-device or resource-constrained environments (quantization, pruning, distillation). Experience with agent frameworks, tool use, or multi-step reasoning systems. Familiarity with prompt engineering, preference optimization (RLHF/DPO), or model alignment techniques. Publications, patents, or open-source contributions in NLP or generative AI. Experience working with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS) and large-scale experimentation infrastructure. The material job duties and responsibilities of this role include those listed above as well as adhering to Yahoo policies; exercising sound judgment; working effectively, safely and inclusively with others; exhibiting trustworthiness and meeting expectations; and safeguarding business operations and brand integrity. At Yahoo, we offer flexible hybrid work options that our employees love! While most roles don’t require regular office attendance, you may occasionally be asked to attend in-person events or team sessions. You’ll always get notice to make arrangements. Your recruiter will let you know if a specific job requires regular attendance at a Yahoo office or facility. If you have any questions about how this applies to the role, just ask the recruiter! Yahoo is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

newJobs.title: Sr. Associate QA Engineer
newJobs.descriptionText: About McKesson Compile Established in 1833, McKesson is a US Fortune 10 global leader in healthcare supply chain management solutions, retail pharmacy, healthcare technology, community oncology, and specialty care. We partner with life sciences companies, manufacturers, providers, pharmacies, governments, and other healthcare organizations to help provide the right medicines, medical products, and healthcare services to the right patients at the right time, safely and cost effectively. Based in Bangalore India, McKesson Compile’s data is a comprehensive, full linked system of record for the US Healthcare market, with intelligence on 2M+ healthcare professionals (HCPs) and over 800K facilities. Compile’s data includes high capture medical and pharmacy claims, closed capture Medicare claims (100%), along with best-in-class provider affiliations and customer master. At McKesson we deliver careers with purpose and potential. Our focus on better health starts with creating an inclusive environment with strong values where you can build a fulfilling career. You can count on us to provide you with resources and opportunities to grow and be your best, while contributing to our pursuit of improving lives. The Sr. Associate QA Automation Engineer is responsible for developing and executing manual and automated testing activities across Ontada's product ecosystem, including AI-enabled and GenAI-powered solutions. Working under the guidance of senior engineers and QA leads, the engineer will contribute to validating web applications, APIs, backend services, data workflows, and AI-driven features to ensure high levels of product quality, reliability, and performance. This role partners closely with Product Managers, Software Engineers, and Operations teams to support the delivery of secure, scalable, and customer-focused healthcare technology solutions. Key Responsibilities Quality Engineering Ownership & Execution Execute test plans and test cases for assigned features and product modules. Participate in requirement reviews and contribute to test scenario identification. Identify and document defects with clear reproduction steps and supporting evidence. Perform functional, integration, regression, and exploratory testing. Support release validation activities across multiple environments. Test Automation & Framework Development Develop and maintain automated test scripts for UI, API, and service-layer testing. Contribute to existing automation frameworks using tools such as Selenium, Playwright, TOSCA, or equivalent technologies. Develop and execute API automation tests using tools such as Postman, RestAssured, or similar frameworks. Support integration of automation suites into CI/CD pipelines. Utilize AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or similar tools to improve productivity and test coverage. AI / GenAI Quality Engineering Assist in validating AI-enabled and GenAI-powered product features. Participate in testing prompt-based workflows and AI-generated responses. Support validation activities focused on response accuracy, consistency, and reliability. Execute predefined test scenarios covering prompt variations and edge cases. Develop familiarity with concepts such as LLMs, prompts, RAG, AI agents, and guardrails. Utilize AI-powered tools to assist with test scenario generation and exploratory testing. Backend & Data Testing Perform backend testing using SQL and/or NoSQL data systems. Validate data ingestion, transformations, persistence, and integrity across services and environments. Assist with testing asynchronous workflows and integrations (e.g., message queues, APIs, batch processes). Agile Collaboration Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and product owners throughout the development lifecycle. Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, grooming, reviews, and retrospectives. Support shift-left testing practices by engaging early in feature development. Quality Governance, Compliance & Continuous Improvement Contribute audit‑ready documentation, including test plans, execution evidence, and reports. Participate in root‑cause discussions for quality issues and contribute to corrective actions. Identify opportunities for improving QA processes, tools, and documentation; contribute suggestions through established continuous improvement channels. Research and evaluate new QA, automation, or performance testing, AI assisted tools and techniques as appropriate. Minimum Requirement Degree or equivalent and typically requires 2+ years of relevant experience. Education Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience. Critical Skills 2+ years of Software Quality Assurance experience. 2+ years of hands-on test automation experience. Experience with at least one automation framework such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or TOSCA. Experience with API testing using Postman, RestAssured, or equivalent tools. Proficiency in Java, Python, or JavaScript. Experience working in Agile development environments. Basic understanding of CI/CD concepts and tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions. Experience with SQL for backend validation and data testing. Familiarity with Git-based source control systems. Additional Skills: Exposure to AI/GenAI testing concepts. Experience testing LLM-powered or AI-enabled applications. Understanding of prompt engineering and prompt validation. Familiarity with RAG architectures and AI evaluation techniques. Knowledge of healthcare technology or regulated environments. Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP. Working Conditions Full-time in office role based in Bangalore, India (IST). Collaboration with distributed, cross‑functional teams. McKesson has become aware of online recruiting-related scams in which individuals who are not affiliated with or authorized by McKesson are using McKesson’s (or affiliated entities, like CoverMyMeds or RxCrossroads) name in fraudulent emails, job postings or social media messages. In light of these scams, please bear the following in mind: McKesson Talent Advisors will never solicit money or credit card information in connection with a McKesson job application. McKesson Talent Advisors do not communicate with candidates via online chatrooms or using email accounts such as Gmail or Hotmail. Note that McKesson does rely on a virtual assistant (Gia) for certain recruiting-related communications with candidates. McKesson job postings are posted on our career site: careers.mckesson.com.
